about.title: About / Professional profile
about.intro: I sit at the intersection of business operations, software engineering and IT systems.
about.paragraph1: Over ten years inside a multi-site organization gave me first-hand knowledge of how operations, business goals and day-to-day constraints actually work — knowledge I now use to scope and coordinate technical initiatives realistically instead of abstractly.
about.paragraph2: In parallel, I've built and maintained backend systems with PHP and Laravel, supported operational continuity with Vue, and taken on Business Systems and IT & Security Operations work: identity and access management, Google Workspace / JumpCloud / 1Password administration, security procedures, and incident coordination.
about.paragraph3: I use Jira to break down and estimate technical initiatives, and I work asynchronously with RabbitMQ-based processes and CircleCI pipelines — enough hands-on exposure to speak the same language as engineering, without presenting myself as a specialist architect.
about.paragraph4: What I bring to a Technical Project/Program Management or Engineering & Platform Operations role is the ability to translate between technology, product, operations and leadership, and to turn that translation into structured, secure, deliverable work.
